risk.rationale: F1 is a single CONFIRMED anomalous sign-in from AS9121 TTNET (TR), outside the account baseline, mapped to T1078.004 (Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts). There are no rejected claims explaining it away and no data-quality conflicts, so it is not benign. However, one isolated authentication event does not by itself constitute a confirmed account takeover chain (no persistence, lateral movement, or further compromise indicators), so contain is not supported. The signal is confirmed-but-unexplained and weak in isolation, fitting monitor rather than escalate (no exposure evidence or conflicting/insufficient data requiring a human).
